config.letterBody:
Do you remember all the afternoons we spent wishing for a shortcut or a magic gadget to make life easier? Looking back at every adventure we have shared, the real magic was never inside the 4D Pocket—it was how you never stopped caring about your friends.

As you turn 21 today, may your skies always stay clear and bright blue, may your plate always have warm dorayaki waiting, and may every door you open lead to a year full of courage, laughter, and unforgettable memories.
config.letterSignOff: With a ringing golden bell & endless cheers, Doraemon 🔔💙
